theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_fcp_local_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ x ∈ M, DifferentiableAt ℝ ν x) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∃ H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H = m ∧ H ≤ A₀ ∧ ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ x ∈ O ∧ O ∩ M = O ∩ (H : Set (Euclid P))
